learnings.title: REST API writes obey GitHub push rulesets; preserve append-only archive writer
learnings.claim: GitHub push rulesets can restrict file paths and also apply to REST API create blob, create tree, and create or update file contents endpoints; private/internal push rulesets require an eligible plan and can block legitimate append writers without a tested bypass.
learnings.decision: ARCHIVE_REST_PUSH_RULESET_GATE: Verify repository visibility, plan, ruleset availability and writer permissions before proposing enforcement. Evaluate mode is NON-BLOCKING telemetry and must never be treated as a successful rejection test. If an eligible push ruleset can be activated safely with explicit approval, validate blocking only on disposable synthetic paths and confirm legitimate append writers remain operational; do not attempt a destructive overwrite of live archives. Until enforcement is proven, use append-only prewrite validation, expected blob SHA, prefix/length checks, and postwrite read-back; CI alone does not prevent direct API overwrite.
learnings.next_measurement: Grok: inspect current repo rulesets/visibility and archive writer permissions read-only; record API result/limits. Add fail-closed synthetic negative test for truncation and positive append test, plus exact commit SHA/CI run. Treat Evaluate as observational only; if push ruleset unsupported, keep code-level writer gate and mark API overwrite prevention unverified.
failure_history: 2026-10-10 prior archive truncations to SEE_FILE / placeholder were reported and repaired; repo-level API enforcement remains unverified.
2026-10-11 correction: previous Evaluate-mode decision incorrectly implied a prohibited overwrite could be blocked in Evaluate; official GitHub ruleset docs confirm it is non-enforcing.
fallback_history: Do not enable a blocking ruleset without proving the legitimate append-only writer is not interrupted; keep existing archive-heal and CI guards as partial protection.
